company.name: Isat Africa
company.shortDescription: Isat Africa offers data, internet, voice, and video solutions using fiber, microwave, satellite, and 3G technologies.
company.description: Isat Africa provides integrated communications services, including data, internet, voice, and video solutions. The company leverages various technologies such as fiber, microwave, satellite, and 3G to offer efficient and affordable connectivity. Isat Africa also focuses on rural connectivity and network as a service, aiming to bridge the digital divide in Africa.
